title: Technical product owner
description:
Nova oportunidade para Technical product owner em esteio. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

ABOUT US  Syniti  , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.  Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.  Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.  Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.  THE ROLE   We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven  Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.  What You’ll Do   Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.  Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.  UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.  Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.  Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.  Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.    WHAT IT TAKES   The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).  The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.  The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.  The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.  The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.  The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.    Key Skills    Visionary Leadership:  Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.   Advanced Governance Concepts:  Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.   AI/ML Application:  Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.   Visual Communication:  Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.   Technical Storyboarding:  Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.   Relationship Orchestration:  Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.  Drive for Results:  Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.    Be fully aligned with our core values:  Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.  Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.  Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.  Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.  By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.   WHAT WE OFFER   Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.  Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.  Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.  Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.  Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.  An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.    OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION  At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.  We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Brazil senior condition intelligence (ci & pm)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Brazil senior condition intelligence (ci & pm) em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Company DescriptionDingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world's largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities. Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.  Role Description As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime. In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo's advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results. With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo's reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence. Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality. Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life. Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics. Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities. Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality. Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records. Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes. Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences. Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management. Qualifications Experience – Minimum of five (5) years' experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable. Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes. Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies. Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions. Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders. Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

title: Risk management officer
description:
Empresa está contratando Risk management officer em valinhos. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Us  Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.  Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.  As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.  Key Responsibilities:   Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.  Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.  Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.  Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;  Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral  Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels  Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures  Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements  Net-worth monitoring;  Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.  Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.  Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.  Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.  Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.    Requirements:   Legally resident in Brazil.  Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.  Demonstrated  independence from commercial functions  and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.   Strong knowledge of  Central Bank of Brazil  risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.   Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.  Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.  Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in  Portuguese and English  .   Must meet  fit and proper  standards with  no disqualifying factors  , including:   not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;  unblemished reputation;  knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;  technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.  not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Brazil senior condition intelligence (ci & pm)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Brazil senior condition intelligence (ci & pm) em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Company Description Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities. Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey. Role Description As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime. In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results. With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence. Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality. Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life. Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics. Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities. Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality. Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records. Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes. Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences. Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management. Qualifications Experience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable. Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes. Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies. Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions. Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders. Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

title: Consultor de energia
description:
Confira a vaga para Consultor de energia em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Empresa O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos. Desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera. Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade. Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Sobre a Função Gerir, otimizar e monetizar o portfólio energético da Arauco Brasil, incluindo autoprodução e comercialização de excedentes no mercado livre e regulado, atuando na interface entre áreas industrial, financeira e jurídica, buscando maximizar resultados econômicos por meio da gestão eficiente de contratos, análise de mercado e conformidade regulatória. Responsabilidades Gerenciar o portfólio de energia da empresa, que inclui geração, consumo, contratos livres e regulados, de curto e longo prazo, convencionais e de autoprodução; Negociar junto a traders, comercializadoras e agentes do setor a compra e venda de energia; Monitorar e analisar o mercado de energia (Preços de curto e longo prazo, oferta e demanda, cenários hidrológicos); Desenvolver estratégias de comercialização do excedente energético e otimizar a alocação de energia entre consumo próprio e venda, visando maximização de receita e redução de custos; Acompanhar e garantir conformidade com regulamentações do setor elétrico; Realizar estudos de viabilidade econômica para novos projetos energéticos (biomassa, cogeração, etc.); Atuar na gestão de riscos (crédito, exposição ao mercado de curto prazo, variação de preços); Apoiar auditorias e reportes institucionais e de sustentabilidade; Se relacionar com as instituições do setor elétrico, incluindo ANEEL, ONS, CCEE, Distribuidoras e Transmissoras de Energia; Contribuir com o planejamento orçamentário e criticar os desvios, bem como elaborar reports para o nível executivo dos resultados da área de energia; Definir com a gestão, criar e acompanhar KPIs relacionados a energia, custos e receita de energia, realizando análises e auxiliando a gestão em decisões estratégicas; Desenvolver e automatizar processos de análise de indicadores através de ferramentas avançadas (BI, Excel, ERP); Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs. Local de atuação São Paulo/ SP Requisitos Graduação em Engenharia (Elétrica, Energia, Produção), Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Energia, Regulação do Setor Elétrico ou áreas afins Conhecimento em Integração Segurança Conhecimento em Ferramentas da qualidade Conhecimento em SAP, Power BI Vivência com autoprodução e/ou cogeração Experiência com comercialização de energia e gestão de contratos livres e regulados Conhecimento técnico em Regulação do setor elétrico brasileiro (ANEEL, CCEE, ONS). Modelos de precificação (Formação do PLD, contratos indexados) Ferramentas de análise de mercado e modelagem energética Experiência em gerenciamento de riscos Conhecimento das regras de autoprodução Diferenciais Inglês e Espanhol avançado Experiência em gerenciamento de riscos Conhecimento das regras de autoprodução

Graphic Designer  Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.  You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.  What you’ll do   You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns  Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web  Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow  Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns  Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG) Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations  Edit video for social distribution and website use  Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative  This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.    What matters in this role   You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction  You understand how design actually shows up in B2 B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio  You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time  You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement  You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks    Requirements   4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams  Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals  Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts) Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video) Video editing experience for social and web content  Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite    Context for the work   Our client sells to B2 B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:  Driving registrations and product demos  Increasing engagement  Supporting sales follow-up  Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders    The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.  What this is not   Not a pure brand exploration role  Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment  Not isolated design work handed over a wall    You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.  If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

About Rate Gain  Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.  Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.  Exploring the role   Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.  The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.  This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.  How your day will look like/Job responsibility   Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs) Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM  Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem  Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements  Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions  Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue  Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends    Education & Work Experience   Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field  5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships    Knowledge:   In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem  Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures  Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors    Skills:   Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities  Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels  Advanced verbal and written communication skills in  Spanish, Portuguese, and English    Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities  Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools  Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)   Attitude:   Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets  Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation  Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team  High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership  Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment     Equal Opportunity Employer   We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Product designer lead (ux/ui)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Product designer lead (ux/ui) em balneário camboriú. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Professional English is a requirement for this role A challenge will be required for evaluation About Foundey Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage Saa S startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products. The Opportunity We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2 B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and Saa S sectors. Responsibilities Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design; Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions; Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and Saa S products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance; Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs; Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite; Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2 B software, and industry best practices in product design; Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team. Requirements Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams; Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools; Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, Fig Jam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle; Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2 B software; Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers; Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles. Preferred Qualifications6+ years of experience as a Product Designer Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.); Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions; Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers; Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams; Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions. Why Join Us?At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing Saa S and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

description:

A Roeslein Brasil abrange mais de 9.000 metros quadrados e é responsável pela fabricação de uma série de equipamentos especializados, incluindo transportadores, sistemas de biogás, skids de petróleo e gás e soluções industriais modulares. A equipe de São Paulo possui expertise profissional em uma ampla gama de serviços avançados de manufatura, incluindo corte a laser, prensagem, soldagem e sistemas de pintura eletrostática. Se você se identifica com o nosso ethos – ser sempre humilde, estar sempre disposto e feliz – confira a vaga disponível abaixo e venha fazer parte da nossa equipe! Atuação: 100% Presencial Região de Atuação: Arujá/SP Horário de Trabalho: Segunda à quinta-feira das 07h às 17h (com 1h para refeição) e sexta-feira das 07h às 16h (com 1h para refeição) Modelo de Trabalho: CLT RESUMO DA POSIÇÃO: Responsável pelo desenvolvimento de projetos elétricos e de automação industrial, incluindo painéis de controle, sistemas de instrumentação e infraestrutura elétrica. Atuará na elaboração da documentação técnica do projeto, desde as fases conceitual e básica até o detalhamento para fabricação e instalação, garantindo conformidade com normas técnicas, especificações de clientes e boas práticas da engenharia. O profissional também apoiará atividades de campo, integração com equipes de engenharia e suporte técnico durante fabricação, montagem e testes de painéis e equipamentos. DEVERES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS: Desenvolver projetos elétricos de painéis de controle e sistemas de automação industrial, garantindo conformidade com requisitos técnicos e especificações do cliente. Elaborar e manter documentação técnica de engenharia, incluindo: Listas de I/O; Diagramas elétricos e diagramas de interligação; Listas de cabos; Listas de materiais (BOM); Arquiteturas de redes de automação; Especificações técnicas de painéis de controle e sistemas associados. Projetar e especificar componentes elétricos e de automação, incluindo circuitos de segurança, módulos de entrada e saída (I/O), redes industriais e sistemas de controle. Realizar Especificação da infraestrutura elétrica, incluindo eletrodutos, eletrocalhas, leitos de cabos, suportações e demais elementos de instalação. Assegurar que os projetos estejam em conformidade com normas técnicas aplicáveis, especificações contratuais e padrões internos de engenharia. Role Overview:   As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

HABILIDADES E CONHECIMENTOS NECESSÁRIOS ➥ Ensino Superior Completo em Ciências Contábeis (CRC ativo ou apto a registro); ➥ Experiência sólida e comprovada em rotinas fiscais de alta complexidade, com elevado grau de autonomia técnica; ➥ Domínio da legislação tributária, normas fiscais e obrigações acessórias; ➥ Vivência prática e aprofundada nos regimes fiscais: Simples Nacional Lucro Presumido (serviços) Lucro Real (serviços)  ➥ Forte capacidade analítica, senso crítico e visão sistêmica dos impactos fiscais no resultado e na estratégia do negócio; ➥ Afinidade com tecnologias aplicadas às rotinas fiscais, automações e ambientes digitais; ➥ Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com capacidade de traduzir temas tributários complexos em orientações claras e objetivas; ➥ Habilidade de relacionamento profissional e postura consultiva junto a clientes e áreas internas; ➥ Domínio do Pacote Office e ferramentas Google Workspace; ➥ Inglês avançadoserá considerado um diferencial. LOCAL ➥ Porto Alegre/RS CARGA HORÁRIA ➥ 40 horas semanais ➥ Das 8h às 12h e das 13h30 às 18h MODALIDADE ➥ Regime de contratação CLT ➥ Modelo de atuação presencial. O QUE A COMECE OFERECE ➥ Ambiente inovador, com forte estímulo ao crescimento técnico e profissional, aprendizado contínuo e troca entre especialistas; ➥ Atuação em projetos relevantes para empresas de tecnologia em diferentes estágios de maturidade; ➥ Vale refeição/alimentação; ➥ Vale transporteou ajuda de custo para deslocamento; ➥ Seguro de Vida; ➥ Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (coparticipação); ➥ Espaço para experimentação, testes e evolução profissional; ➥ Free coffee ; ➥ Ambiente descontraído e colaborativo; DADOS DE APOIO AO CANDIDATO ORIENTAÇÕES PARA ENVIO DO CURRÍCULO (REQUISITO OBRIGATÓRIO) O currículo deverá evidenciar de forma clara, objetiva e comprovável a experiência prática do candidato em rotinas fiscais complexas, com atuação direta na apuração, revisão crítica e validação de tributos em diferentes regimes tributários. Serão considerados apenas currículos que atendam aos seguintes critérios: 1. DESCRIÇÃO DETALHADA DA EXPERIÊNCIA TÉCNICA O candidato deve apresentar, para cada experiência profissional relevante: Nome da empresa Período de atuação Cargo ocupado Descrição objetiva das atividades executadas, com foco em: Apuração de tributos (Simples Nacional, Lucro Presumido e Lucro Real) Participação ativa em fechamentos fiscais mensais Revisões críticas, validações e análises de apuração tributária Entregas de obrigações acessórias (SPEDs, ECF, ECD, etc.) Conciliações fiscais e contábeis Identificação de inconsistências, riscos fiscais e ajustes necessários Interação com clientes ou áreas internas em temas fiscais relevantes Não serão considerados currículos com descrições genéricas, superficiais ou sem evidência de atuação prática. 2. COMPROVAÇÃO DE ATUAÇÃO PRÁTICA O currículo deve deixar evidente: Nível de autonomia na execução das rotinas fiscais Participação direta em fechamentos fiscais completos Complexidade das empresas atendidas (porte, volume de operações, regimes tributários) Envolvimento em revisões técnicas, validações ou análises críticas Atuação na identificação e tratamento de riscos fiscais 3. REFERÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS (OBRIGATÓRIO) O candidato deverá informar, no mínimo, 3 referências profissionais diretas, vinculadas à sua atuação técnica. Cada referência deve conter obrigatoriamente: Nome da empresa Nome completo do contato Cargo do contato Relação profissional com o candidato (ex: gestor direto, sócio, cliente, líder técnico, etc.) E-mail corporativo Telefone para contato As referências poderão ser contatadas durante o processo seletivo para validação técnica, nível de autonomia e qualidade das entregas realizadas. 4. Não buscamos profissionais com atuação exclusivamente operacional ou com dependência constante de validação técnica. Buscamos profissionais com capacidade de: Analisar criticamente as apurações Identificar riscos e inconsistências Propor melhorias e sustentar decisões técnicas Atuar com postura consultiva junto a clientes e equipe Currículos que não atendam aos critérios acima poderão ser desconsiderados automaticamente.

➥ Domínio do Pacote Office e ferramentas Google Workspace; LOCAL ➥ Porto Alegre/RS CARGA HORÁRIA ➥ 40 horas semanais ➥ Das 8h às 12h e das 13h30 às 18h MODALIDADE ➥ Regime de contratação CLT ➥ Modelo de atuação presencial O QUE A COMECE OFERECE ➥ Ambiente inovador, com forte estímulo ao crescimento técnico e profissional, aprendizado contínuo e troca entre especialistas; ➥ Atuação em projetos relevantes para empresas de tecnologia em tração e maturidade, com alta complexidade tributária; ➥ Vale refeição/alimentação; ➥ Vale transporteou ajuda de custo para deslocamento; DESCRIÇÃO DETALHADA DA EXPERIÊNCIA TÉCNICA O candidato deve apresentar, para cada experiência profissional relevante: Nome da empresa Período de atuação Cargo ocupado Descrição objetiva das atividades executadas, com foco em: Apuração de tributos no Lucro Real Rotinas fiscais nos regimes Lucro Real, Presumido e/ou Simples Nacional Participação ativa em fechamentos fiscais mensais Revisões críticas, validações e análises de apuração tributária Atuação em ajustes fiscais (adições, exclusões, compensações) Conciliações fiscais e contábeis Interação com clientes ou áreas internas em temas fiscais relevantes Não serão considerados currículos com descrições genéricas, superficiais ou sem evidência de atuação prática. 2. COMPROVAÇÃO DE ATUAÇÃO PRÁTICA O currículo deve deixar evidente: Nível de autonomia na execução das apurações fiscais Participação direta em fechamentos fiscais completos Complexidade das empresas atendidas (porte, faturamento, volume de operações, regime tributário) Envolvimento em análises críticas, revisões técnicas ou identificação de riscos fiscais 3. REFERÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS (OBRIGATÓRIO) O candidato deverá informar, no mínimo, 3 referências profissionais diretas, vinculadas à sua atuação técnica. Cada referência deve conter obrigatoriamente: Nome da empresa Nome completo do contato Cargo do contato Relação profissional com o candidato (ex: gestor direto, sócio, cliente, líder técnico, etc.) E-mail corporativo Telefone para contato As referências poderão ser contatadas durante o processo seletivo para validação técnica, nível de autonomia e qualidade das entregas realizadas. 4. Não buscamos profissionais com atuação apenas operacional ou suporte parcial. Buscamos profissionais com capacidade de analisar, revisar, validar e sustentar tecnicamente as apurações fiscais, atuando como referência dentro do time e junto aos clientes. Currículos que não atendam aos critérios acima poderão ser desconsiderados automaticamente.

title: Product designer lead (ux/ui)
description:
Confira a vaga para Product designer lead (ux/ui) em rio do sul. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Professional English is a requirement for this role A challenge will be required for evaluation About Foundey Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage Saa S startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products. The Opportunity We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2 B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and Saa S sectors. Responsibilities Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design; Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions; Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and Saa S products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance; Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs; Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite; Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2 B software, and industry best practices in product design; Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team. Requirements Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams; Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools; Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, Fig Jam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle; Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2 B software; Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers; Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles. Preferred Qualifications6+ years of experience as a Product Designer Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.); Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions; Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers; Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams; Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions. Why Join Us?At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing Saa S and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Senior voip engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior voip engineer em são leopoldo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the role  We are hiring a  Senior Vo IP Engineer  to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  This role sits at the intersection of  telecom, networking, and software engineering  , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.  This is a  developer role  — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.  What you'll do  Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.  Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.  Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.  Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.  Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.    What we're looking for:  Required   5+ years as a developer  building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.  Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:     A B2 BUA / media server:  Asterisk or Free SWITCH   A SIP proxy / routing layer:  Kamailio or Open SIPS   Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.  Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.  Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.  Advanced English proficiency  (written and spoken).   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.    Strong plus    Python  for automation, tooling, or service development.   SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).  Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).  Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).  Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.  Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.    Why this role   Fully remote with a flexible working model.  Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.  High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.  Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.  Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Product designer lead (ux/ui)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Product designer lead (ux/ui) em arujá. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Professional English is a requirement for this role A challenge will be required for evaluation About Foundey Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage Saa S startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products. The Opportunity We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2 B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and Saa S sectors. Responsibilities Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design; Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions; Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and Saa S products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance; Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs; Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite; Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2 B software, and industry best practices in product design; Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team. Requirements Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams; Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools; Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, Fig Jam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle; Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2 B software; Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers; Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles. Preferred Qualifications6+ years of experience as a Product Designer Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.); Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions; Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers; Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams; Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions. Why Join Us?At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing Saa S and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).  Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).
